title: Enterprise plugin market
intro: Administrators import plugins. Employees with an active seat can install and use validated plugins while connected to the enterprise service.
name: Plugin
loadFailed: The operation failed. Please try again.
empty: Import an offline release bundle to publish your first plugin.
uploadHint: Complete offline ZIP, up to 512 MiB; extracted size up to 1 GiB. Higher versions can update an existing plugin.
invalidFile: Select a ZIP or npm tgz bundle up to 512 MiB
deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? New installations and updates will stop. Installed plugins pause when the seat is revoked or the connection drops, and resume from the previous switch after reconnect if the seat is still valid. You can import the plugin again later.
bundleHelp: Import an offline bundle that contains manifest.json, or a ZIP / npm tgz that contains package.json. Use standard SemVer.
previewFailed: Preview failed. Check ZIP format, size and connection, then select the file again.
lowerVersion: Choose a higher version; older versions are unsupported.
versionConflict: This version already has different content. Use a new version number.
duplicateVersion: Already imported. The existing version will be reused.
versionReady: After confirmation, employees with an active seat can install this version from Client.
